transcript.text: Our Samsung combi microwave keeps whirring for a few minutes after it's finished and beeped, even with the door open. Old one never did that. Is the fan stuck on?

Probably not. A combi microwave commonly keeps its cooling fan running for a short time after the programme ends, including with the door open, to cool the microwave/grill components. Your previous microwave may simply not have had that feature, or may have used a shorter run-on time. 1. Let it finish normally and time the noise once. If it stops by itself after a few minutes, with no burning smell, overheating or error message, that is usually normal.
2. Make sure the external ventilation openings are not covered and the appliance has space for air to escape. Restricted airflow can make the fan run longer. It becomes more suspicious if it runs for a very long time or never stops, is unusually loud or scraping, the microwave gets excessively hot, or there is a hot/burning smell. In that case stop using the microwave and arrange an engineer inspection; do not remove the casing, as microwaves contain hazardous high-voltage parts even unplugged. Does the whirring stop by itself after a few minutes each time, or does it continue for much longer/indefinitely?

Yes, it stops by itself after a few minutes each time. It's longest after using the grill or convection, and after a short reheat it barely runs. No burning smell, and it's only warm on top after the grill.

That pattern is normal for a combi microwave, not a fan stuck on. The cooling fan runs longer after grill or convection cooking because those modes heat the cabinet and grill area more; a very short run after a quick microwave reheat is also what we would expect. Stopping by itself after a few minutes, with no burning smell and only normal warmth on top, is reassuring. No repair is indicated. It would only need investigating if the fan began to run indefinitely, became noisy/scraping, the appliance overheated, or there was a hot electrical/burning smell.

candidates: Cooling fan/control fault if it runs excessively or never stops (low)
